QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Express Permission
QuestInfo.0: Talk to the Temple Keeper for permission to pass through the Temple of Time.
QuestInfo.1: The Temple Keeper may have only spoken briefly of the Ryuul, but you feel compelled by the power of his words when he tells you to defeat monsters in a highly restricted area. The only way you could accomplish that is by using the power of the Eluna Express.
QuestInfo.2: His request seemed to contradict the laws of the temple, but perhaps there are exceptions for special circumstances like this.
